faq.q: What areas does "Cloverdale homes under $1.8M" actually cover?
faq.a: Detached homes under a $1.8M ceiling across the whole Cloverdale board community — the feed's visible cards carry both "Cloverdale BC" and "Clayton" sub-area labels, so the page spans the Cloverdale and Clayton sub-areas (Serpentine recorded no listings in September 2026) (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: What is the median detached price in Cloverdale?
faq.a: At community level (the only level SnapStats publishes medians), Cloverdale detached recorded a $1,212,500 median sale price in September 2026, with 201 active listings, 32 sales and 19 days on market — $587,500 below this page's ceiling by arithmetic comparison.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Cloverdale?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Cloverdale?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.
